verdict: Purchases dropped sharply this week; one campaign is being rebalanced now.
narrative: This period your Meta ads delivered 34 purchases and $7,526 in revenue at a 5.16 return on ad spend (ROAS) across 28 days, but the last seven days saw ROAS fall 66% week-over-week as purchases nearly stopped — only 1 purchase in the last three days versus 8 in the three days prior. The concentration of over half your ad budget ($754.99 of $1,457.78) in the new Muslim Subscription Box campaign, which is still finding its audience, is the most likely driver of that stall. Separately, steady daily site traffic (~230 sessions/day) converting to zero revenue on 10 of the last 17 days points to friction on the subscription page, which is actively being addressed. Budget allocation across campaigns is being rebalanced this week, and a creative refresh is in motion to address audience fatigue on existing ads.

highlights.phrase: Return on ad spend across the full 28-day window
ROAS drop this past week versus the week prior
Spend concentrated in the new subscription box campaign — 52% of total budget

watch_item.issue: The new Muslim Subscription Box campaign has flatlined on purchases while absorbing the majority of weekly budget.
watch_item.fix: Budget is being redistributed across campaigns this week and ad creative is being refreshed to relieve audience fatigue.
